tools.name: validate_vatid_format
tools.description: Free EU VAT-ID FORMAT check (syntax only, no registry lookup), rate-limited per IP, no API key needed. For a live VIES registry check use the paid validate_vatid tool (5 credits).

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Validate an email address: syntax, disposable-domain check, MX record via DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns a deliverability verdict. 2 credits, requires an API key.

tools.name: validate_vatid
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT ID against the live VIES registry (format check first — an invalid format still costs the full price, it never reaches VIES but you got an answer). 5 credits, requires an API key.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate an IBAN (ISO 13616 check digits) incl. SEPA membership. 2 credits, requires an API key.

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a person or company against the official EU, US (OFAC SDN) and UK (OFSI) sanctions lists. Fuzzy name matching with an auditable reason per hit — review every hit yourself; a clean result is not legal clearance and covers no PEP data. 15 credits, requires an API key.

tools.name: verify_company
tools.description: Verify a business partner in one call: EU VAT registration (VIES), LEI register (GLEIF), IBAN checksum and country consistency — one verdict (pass|fail|inconclusive) with an auditable check log. Provide at least one of name, vatId, lei. Does not include commercial-register existence checks. 150 cred

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_email · Private data: validate_vatid_format, validate_email, validate_vatid, validate_iban, screen_sanctions, verify_company · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: validate_vatid_format, validate_vatid.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_email · Private data: validate_vatid_format, validate_email, validate_vatid, validate_iban, screen_sanctions, verify_company · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: validate_vatid_format, validate_vatid

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
